args.title: Prevent CSV rows with same date/amount/description but different currencies from merging
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The CSV writer currently merges rows that share the same date, amount, and description, even if their currencies differ. This causes rows with different currencies (e.g., EUR and USD) to be combined into a single row, dropping one of them. The fix should ensure that rows are only merged when all fields, including currency, are identical. This aligns with the expected behavior where transactions with distinct currencies should remain separate in the exported CSV.
